tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text and headings, on background, card, muted, accent and primary-soft. Also the tooltip's fill, with background as its text.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: badges at rest, inline code, trays, read-only fields and buttons that can't be used. A step lighter than card in dark too, so a chip or a read-only field shows on a card.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: The empty part of a progress bar, the steps still to come and a slider's track.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, dates, counts, table headers. On background, card, muted and sidebar.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, inputs, checkboxes at rest.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card edges, dividers, table headers.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Borders of fields, outline buttons and checkboxes; at least 3:1 on every surface (card, page, sidebar, muted).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one main action per view and checked checkboxes (also as text on background and card).

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and ticks on primary.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button under the pointer; primary-foreground on it. Also teal words on primary-soft (a button that stays on).

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Notice alerts and buttons that stay on (with primary-hover words); foreground and muted-foreground read on it.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover fill for ghost buttons, menu items and table rows; foreground, muted-foreground and destructive read on it.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar ground; foreground and muted-foreground read on it.

tokens.name: sidebar-hover
tokens.usage: Sidebar row under the pointer; foreground reads on it.

tokens.name: sidebar-active
tokens.usage: The row for the page you are on (aria-current="page"): a flat white pill in light, a slate pill in dark. Its text, icon and count keep their usual colours. Also the fill of the raised pill (a toolbar tool under the pointer, the chosen segment).

tokens.name: sidebar-active-foreground
tokens.usage: Text of the active row: the same as every other row (foreground). Only the pill behind it changes.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Late dates and counts, delete actions: a red outline on a page, solid as a dialog's Delete. On background, card and sidebar; a late count is also bold, so it never relies on colour alone.

tokens.name: destructive-hover
tokens.usage: A solid red button (a dialog's Delete) under the pointer; destructive-foreground on it.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Words on destructive and destructive-hover (a solid red button). Dark words in dark: white on that red is 2.4:1.

tokens.name: destructive-soft
tokens.usage: Error alerts, destructive badges and the hover of delete buttons; destructive text reads on it.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Amber: what needs attention soon but isn't wrong yet (due soon, a session about to end, offline). Warning alerts, badges and toast icons; on background, card and sidebar, always with an icon or words, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning alerts and badges; warning text reads on it.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus only: a blue of its own, so focus shows on teal buttons and ticked boxes too. At least 3:1 on background, card and sidebar.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind an open dialog.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Same as foreground. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use foreground in new code.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Same as foreground. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use foreground in new code.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Same as card. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use card in new code.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Same as foreground. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use foreground in new code.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Same as muted. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use muted in new code.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Same as foreground. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use foreground in new code.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Same as sidebar-hover. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use sidebar-hover in new code.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Same as foreground. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use foreground in new code.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Same as border. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use border in new code.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Same as primary. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use primary in new code.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Same as primary-foreground. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use primary-foreground in new code.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Same as ring. Kept so idp's existing class names keep working; use ring in new code.

tokens.name: media
tokens.usage: Behind a video, and a still before it plays.

tokens.name: media-scrim
tokens.usage: Behind words on a video (its length).

tokens.name: on-media
tokens.usage: The play button on a video, and words on the scrim; the same in both themes.

tokens.name: on-media-foreground
tokens.usage: The play icon on that white button.

tokens.name: on-media-hover
tokens.usage: The play button under the pointer.

tokens.name: knob
tokens.usage: A switch's knob, in both themes.

tokens.name: colour-gray
tokens.usage: The gray a person can give a list or a label; the same in both themes.

tokens.name: colour-red
tokens.usage: The red a person can give a list or a label; the same in both themes.

tokens.name: colour-orange
tokens.usage: The orange a person can give a list or a label; the same in both themes.

tokens.name: colour-yellow
tokens.usage: The yellow a person can give a list or a label; the same in both themes.

tokens.name: colour-green
tokens.usage: The green a person can give a list or a label; the same in both themes.

tokens.name: colour-teal
tokens.usage: The teal a person can give a list or a label; the same in both themes.

tokens.name: colour-blue
tokens.usage: The blue a person can give a list or a label; the same in both themes.

tokens.name: colour-purple
tokens.usage: The purple a person can give a list or a label; the same in both themes.

tokens.name: colour-pink
tokens.usage: The pink a person can give a list or a label; the same in both themes.

groups.name: Senin
groups.note: Figtree, friendly and open. One scale of ten sizes, each with its own line height: 10/14, 12/16, 14/20, 16/24, 18/24, 22/28, 28/36, 40/48, and 56/64 and 72/80 for a hero only. The named styles are the sizes in use today.

styles.name: pc-title
styles.usage: Page titles; a number on a stat.

styles.name: pc-heading
styles.usage: Card, dialog, drawer and section titles; the sidebar app name; a large button's words.

styles.name: pc-body
styles.sample: Send the contract draft to the Denver team

styles.name: pc-small
styles.usage: Dates, counts, descriptions, hints (labels are 600, a tooltip and a field's error 500).

styles.name: pc-tiny
styles.usage: Letters in an app's mark or an avatar, a small badge's count.

styles.name: pc-text-18
styles.usage: Free step: a lead line under a page title.

styles.name: pc-text-28
styles.usage: Free step: big numbers, a section title on a landing page.

styles.name: pc-text-40
styles.usage: Free step: a landing page's title.

styles.name: pc-text-72
styles.usage: A hero's title on a wide screen.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: The system's own monospace; no font file to host.

styles.name: pc-mono
styles.usage: Client IDs, secrets, error codes, job arguments.

spacing.note: Ten steps, 2px apart up to 12, then 16, 24, 32 and 48; nothing else (14 became 12). Sizes that add up others (room for an icon inside a field) are sums of steps. One row height for sidebar rows, table rows, buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: pc-space-0-5
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: between sidebar rows, an icon and its first line of text.

tokens.name: pc-space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a badge; around rows in a menu.

tokens.name: pc-space-1-5
tokens.usage: Icon to words inside a button, a tab or a chip.

tokens.name: pc-space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls.

tokens.name: pc-space-2-5
tokens.usage: The inside edge of fields and menu rows; above and below the words in an alert; icon to words in a sidebar row.

tokens.name: pc-space-3
tokens.usage: Between fields in a form; the inside edge of an alert or a toast.

tokens.name: pc-space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: pc-space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding, between cards.

tokens.name: pc-space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections of a page.

tokens.name: pc-space-12
tokens.usage: Around a hero and between the big blocks of a landing page.

tokens.name: pc-row
tokens.usage: Height of every row and control: sidebar, menu, search and table rows, calendar days, buttons, inputs and selects. 40px on phones (under 48rem wide), where fields also take 16px text so iPhones don't zoom in.

radius.note: Four steps and round. Checkboxes stay square-ish; avatars and badges are round.

tokens.name: pc-radius-xs
tokens.usage: Focus rings around links, the tab underline and the bar marking the current place in a menu.

tokens.name: pc-radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, key caps, inline code, Skeleton blocks and the small marks (an app's mark, a space's letter).

tokens.name: pc-radius
tokens.usage: Rows, buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: pc-radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, dialogs, popovers, toasts, sheets and the app frame.

tokens.name: pc-radius-full
tokens.usage: Round: avatars, badges, chips, radios, switches, sliders and dots.

shadow.note: Two lifts: pc-raise for cards; pc-raise-lg for menus, dialogs and tooltips; pc-focus for keyboard focus on controls, pc-focus-inset on rows.

tokens.name: pc-raise
tokens.usage: Cards, the raised pill (a toolbar tool under the pointer, the chosen segment) and the slider's handle.

tokens.name: pc-raise-lg
tokens.usage: Things that open over the page: menus, dialogs, tooltips.

tokens.name: pc-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control (rows take pc-focus-inset): a 1px ring line on the edge and a soft glow in a darker blue. Each control also turns its own outer 1px into the colour of the surface behind it (as on claude.ai).

tokens.name: pc-focus-inset
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on rows (sidebar, menu, search, calendar days, table rows), as on claude.ai: the 1px ring inside the row's own edge, only the glow outside.

tokens.name: pc-raise-sm
tokens.usage: A switch's knob.

tokens.name: pc-raise-media
tokens.usage: The play button over a video.

tokens.name: pc-focus-offset
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on something filled teal inside a card or popover (a chosen day or month): a ring 2px off its edge.

size.note: Fixed squares, six steps: icons (12 the smallest marks, 16 beside words, 20 on their own, 24 in a large avatar) and boxes that don't follow the row: checkboxes 16, badges and handles 20, avatars 24, 32, 48.

tokens.name: pc-size-12
tokens.usage: The smallest marks: a sort arrow, a breadcrumb's arrow, the colour picker's plus; a small spinner.

tokens.name: pc-size-16
tokens.usage: Icons beside words; checkboxes, radios, the small badge.

tokens.name: pc-size-20
tokens.usage: An icon on its own; badges, key caps, a slider's handle, a switch's height.

tokens.name: pc-size-24
tokens.usage: An avatar beside one line; an icon in a large avatar.

tokens.name: pc-size-32
tokens.usage: An avatar beside two lines.

tokens.name: pc-size-48
tokens.usage: A person's page avatar; the video's play button; the search window's field.

text.note: Ten text sizes, each with its own line height (pc-line-N): 56 and 72 for a hero only.

tokens.name: pc-text-10
tokens.usage: Text size 10; its line is pc-line-10.

tokens.name: pc-line-10
tokens.usage: The line height of 10px text.

tokens.name: pc-text-12
tokens.usage: Text size 12; its line is pc-line-12.

tokens.name: pc-line-12
tokens.usage: The line height of 12px text.

tokens.name: pc-text-14
tokens.usage: Text size 14; its line is pc-line-14.

tokens.name: pc-line-14
tokens.usage: The line height of 14px text.

tokens.name: pc-text-16
tokens.usage: Text size 16; its line is pc-line-16.

tokens.name: pc-line-16
tokens.usage: The line height of 16px text.

tokens.name: pc-text-18
tokens.usage: Text size 18; its line is pc-line-18.

tokens.name: pc-line-18
tokens.usage: The line height of 18px text.

tokens.name: pc-text-22
tokens.usage: Text size 22; its line is pc-line-22.

tokens.name: pc-line-22
tokens.usage: The line height of 22px text.

tokens.name: pc-text-28
tokens.usage: Text size 28; its line is pc-line-28.

tokens.name: pc-line-28
tokens.usage: The line height of 28px text.

tokens.name: pc-text-40
tokens.usage: Text size 40; its line is pc-line-40.

tokens.name: pc-line-40
tokens.usage: The line height of 40px text.

tokens.name: pc-text-56
tokens.usage: Text size 56; its line is pc-line-56.

tokens.name: pc-line-56
tokens.usage: The line height of 56px text.

tokens.name: pc-text-72
tokens.usage: Text size 72; its line is pc-line-72.

tokens.name: pc-line-72
tokens.usage: The line height of 72px text.

width.note: Seven widths for what opens or holds a column; on a narrow screen each is capped at the screen less its padding.

tokens.name: pc-width-160
tokens.usage: The label column of a details list; footer link columns.

tokens.name: pc-width-240
tokens.usage: Menus at their narrowest, a tooltip at its widest, a dialog's side list.

tokens.name: pc-width-256
tokens.usage: The sidebar; its sheet on phones.

tokens.name: pc-width-320
tokens.usage: Popovers at their widest.

tokens.name: pc-width-400
tokens.usage: Dialogs, drawers, toasts; the sign-in form on every screen.

tokens.name: pc-width-560
tokens.usage: The search window.

tokens.name: pc-width-960
tokens.usage: The settings window (a dialog with a side list); the page column under the header.

height.note: Three heights for what scrolls inside itself.

tokens.name: pc-height-list
tokens.usage: A list that scrolls: a Select's menu, search results, a block of output.

tokens.name: pc-height-panel
tokens.usage: The settings window.

tokens.name: pc-height-sheet
tokens.usage: A sheet from the bottom on phones, at its tallest.

border.note: Edges and the lines around focus.

tokens.name: pc-border
tokens.usage: Every edge: fields, buttons, cards, dividers, underlines.

tokens.name: pc-border-2
tokens.usage: Heavier lines: the tab underline, a quote's line, rings around avatars and swatches.

tokens.name: pc-underline-offset
tokens.usage: Room between words and their underline.

tokens.name: pc-focus-outline
tokens.usage: Under every focus ring: a line only Windows' high-contrast mode draws.

tokens.name: pc-focus-outline-offset
tokens.usage: Where that line sits, just outside the edge.

tokens.name: pc-bar-2
tokens.usage: The finest bars: a slider's marks, the line marking the current app.

tokens.name: pc-bar-4
tokens.usage: A small progress bar, the steps of a progress indicator.

tokens.name: pc-bar-6
tokens.usage: A progress bar, a slider's track.

tokens.name: pc-dot-8
tokens.usage: A chosen radio's dot, carousel dots, the online dot on a small avatar.

tokens.name: pc-dot-10
tokens.usage: A colour dot in a menu, the online dot on a 32px avatar.

tokens.name: pc-dot-12
tokens.usage: The online dot on a 48px avatar.

opacity.note: One fading and four strengths of mixing a colour into another.

tokens.name: pc-opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Everything that can't be used (buttons have their own grey look).

tokens.name: pc-mix-edge
tokens.usage: A faint edge from the text colour: around photos and swatches; the alert's x under the pointer.

tokens.name: pc-mix-tint
tokens.usage: A soft teal: a soft badge, a chosen box, the range of dates.

tokens.name: pc-mix-line
tokens.usage: A quiet line: a link's underline, a scrollbar.

tokens.name: pc-mix-hover
tokens.usage: The segmented control's option under the pointer.

tokens.name: pc-weight-regular
tokens.usage: Body text.

tokens.name: pc-weight-medium
tokens.usage: Links, tooltips, a field's error.

tokens.name: pc-weight-semibold
tokens.usage: Labels, titles, buttons, chips.

tokens.name: pc-weight-bold
tokens.usage: Page titles, today's date.

tokens.name: pc-tracking-tight
tokens.usage: Page titles (22) and up to 40.

tokens.name: pc-tracking-tighter
tokens.usage: A hero's 56 and 72.

layer.note: What sits over what, bottom to top. Dialogs open in the browser's top layer, above all of these.

tokens.name: pc-layer-raised
tokens.usage: A card's header action and a table's controls, above the link that covers the card or row.

tokens.name: pc-layer-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips.

tokens.name: pc-layer-menu
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers that open from a button.

tokens.name: pc-layer-drawer
tokens.usage: The drawer beside the page and the sidebar's sheet.

tokens.name: pc-layer-backdrop
tokens.usage: The dimmed page behind a sheet on phones.

tokens.name: pc-layer-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers when they open as sheets on phones.

tokens.name: pc-layer-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: pc-layer-skip-link
tokens.usage: The skip link.
